title: Alljoined1
description: Alljoined1 is an EEG dataset of neural responses to natural images presented in a rapid serial visual presentation paradigm, built for EEG-to-image decoding research. Eight healthy adults viewed images from the Natural Scenes Dataset (MS-COCO) while 64-channel BioSemi EEG was recorded across one or two sessions. This BIDS version contains raw BDF recordings of 960 shared images, event tables linked to stimuli, and epoched derivatives from the original authors.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz. Participants viewed natural images for 300 ms each, followed by 300 ms of black screen plus 0-50 ms of jitter, and pressed a key on consecutive repeated images (oddball detection). Derivative preprocessing comprised 0.5-125 Hz band-pass filtering, a 60 Hz notch filter, FastICA, epoching from -50 to 600 ms, AutoReject artifact rejection, baseline correction and average re-referencing.
